description: This test verifies that a user can successfully log in using the Google OAuth login option.
steps: Locate and click the 'Sign in with Google' button.
Verify that the Google OAuth login page is displayed.
Enter valid Google account credentials and submit.
Verify redirection back to the Roost dashboard (https://dev.roost.ai) upon successful authentication.
Validate that the user is logged in and their profile data is displayed correctly.
expected_results: Google OAuth login page is displayed.
User is redirected to the Roost dashboard upon successful login.
User profile data is visible on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Google account does not have the required permissions.
data_requirements: Pre-configured Google OAuth client ID and redirect URI.
Access to a test user account on the Roost platform.
OAuth configuration in the Roost backend.
A valid SSL certificate for the login page.
dependencies: User is not already logged in on another browser session.
OAuth client ID and secret are correctly configured in the application.
Test user account is active in the Roost platform.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect from Google OAuth to the Roost dashboard.
Page load time for the dashboard after login.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Sign in with Google' button has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify the login flow is navigable via keyboard only.
Check for screen reader compatibility on the login page.
Ensure high contrast for all interactive elements.
Verify proper focus management during modal transitions.
